title: Zero external dependencies — hand-rolled HTTP/1.1 server over raw libsqlite3
evidence: Package.swift declares only a CSQLite system-library target (no .package()); Server.swift:20-74 parses HTTP manually over POSIX sockets
suggestion: None — this fully meets the spec; noted as a design characteristic for cross-run comparison.

title: Persistence stores full record as a JSON document column plus denormalized author
evidence: Books.swift:42 schema `books(id, author TEXT, document TEXT)`; save() writes JSON document (Books.swift:83-90), author duplicated to support ?author= filter
suggestion: None — SQLite requirement (R7) is satisfied; denormalization is an intentional tradeoff.

title: Server is synchronous and handles one request per connection (Connection: close)
evidence: Server.swift:64 sends `Connection: close`; serve() processes a single request then closes the fd (Server.swift:50-74)
suggestion: Acceptable for the task; no keep-alive/concurrency required by the spec.
